services.name: Stand-Up Paddle boards – 1-7 Day Rentals
services.desc: Rates Starting at $55 About Aussie Watersports rents out Riviera stand-up paddle boards (SUPs) in Northern Michigan with free delivery to the greater Traverse City area. SUPs are a great (and simple) way to explore the beautiful waters of Northern Michigan – and we have A LOT of beautiful waters to explore. Whether you’re looking for a fun way to enjoy the Grand Traverse Bay with the kids or you want to check out one of our many lakes, SUPs are easy to transport and the perfect toy for a summer day. Northern Michigan Stand-Up Paddle Board Daily Rentals We offer daily stand-up paddle board rentals from our downtown Traverse City location at the Bayshore Resort on West Grand Traverse Bay.
